correctness.rationale: For all a>0 the positive Legendre moments obey the proven A_(n+2)/A_n recurrence. Applying the exact three-term recurrence twice computes B_n/A_n=R_n. The positive denominator identity for R_(n+1)-R_n has numerator F_z(n); its coefficients have exactly one sign change and F_z(0)>0, forcing a single real positive optimizer crossing. Schoenberg turns all-degree positivity into exactly the given b bounds; infinitely many positive coefficients of each parity prove strictness at boundaries. The actual standalone check.py passed exact algebra and independent numerical integrals. No finite computation is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The geodesic exponential is a standard spherical covariance model and second angular harmonic is a natural oscillatory/hole-effect perturbation. The exact full admissible parameter cone identifies whether every finite covariance matrix is valid, including a sharp pure-wave damping boundary a=sqrt(3). The determining Legendre degree increases unboundedly with a, yielding a nontrivial infinite phase staircase and an exact finite algebraic parameter test, not a routine fixed-degree table or mere restatement of Schoenberg positivity.
